import sys

def main():
    in_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    p = in_line.split(" ")
    a = int(p[0])
    b = int(p[1])
    
    aa = a % 2 == 0
    bb = b % 2 == 0
    
    in_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    q = in_line.split(" ")
    c = int(q[0])
    d = int(q[1])
    
    cc = c % 2 == 0
    dd = d % 2 == 0
    
    if not ((!bb and aa and dd and cc) or (not dd and cc and bb and aa)):
        while b != d:
            if b < d:
                b += a
            else:
                d += c
            if d > 10000000:
                b = -1
                d = -1
                break
        sys.stdout.write(f"{b}\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
